mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS (User_SID, ID, Password, Email, Age, Address, Card_Num) VALUES (#{userSid}, #{id}, #{password}, #{email}, #{age}, #{address}, #{cardNum})
mapper.select: SELECT User_SID AS userSid, ID AS id, Password AS password, Email AS email, Age AS age, Address AS address, Card_Num AS cardNum FROM USERS WHERE ID = #{id} AND Password = #{password}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS WHERE ID = #{id}
SELECT User_SID AS userSid, ID AS id, Password AS password, Email AS email, Age AS age, Address AS address, Card_Num AS cardNum FROM USERS WHERE User_SID = #{userSid}
SELECT User_SID AS userSid, ID AS id, Password AS password, Email AS email, Age AS age, Address AS address, Card_Num AS cardNum FROM USERS ORDER BY User_SID
